title: Approval record — the signed consent object (D44, C-5)
description: Outline from goal-file-schema-reconciliation-2026-08-15.md §11 (§18 item 1); not this document's tested surface — §14.2 review and the fixture set land with the family, not this pass. The signed object is the JCS bytes of this record with `signature` removed (C-5, replacing E1 §5.1's hash-concatenation formula, whose optional briefing member was an encoding-ambiguity hazard). DC-2 applies in full: per-target validity, device nonce, monotonic-counter single use, persisted rejects. Grok's `H(projected_augments)` extension is dropped — with the device-side projector there is no shipped projection to bind (map §9 preamble).

schema_version.description: Family version, shared with goal-file and goal-diff (§11).

host.description: The target key this record is valid for — DC-2's per-target validity.

baseline_sha256.description: H(old canonical goal file). Absent ONLY at first adoption, where there is no prior approved baseline to name — a named §14.2 review target (TC-11/TC-20 territory), not a property this outline claims to have fully worked out.

proposed_sha256.description: H(new canonical goal file) — what `verdict` is a verdict about.

nonce.description: Device-issued, single-use (DC-2). Exact byte encoding is residue, not decided here — this outline states only that it is present and opaque.

approval_seq.description: Monotonic counter, DC-2 single-use: the validator rejects any record whose approval_seq does not exceed the last persisted one for this host.

briefing_sha256.description: Optional: binds the record to the briefing bytes the person actually saw, when one was shown.

verdict.description: What the approver decided about proposed_sha256.

refused.description: Hunk key-paths the refusal is annotated with. Present iff verdict is reject; annotation only — it does not change what was refused (all of it, §9.3's all-or-nothing rule), only explains why, so the proposer knows what to re-render.

ceremony_class.description: Asserted by the approver, checked against the validator's own DERIVED requirement (map §9.8) — a mismatch is refused, never silently upgraded or downgraded.

signature.description: Detached signature over the JCS bytes of this record with this member removed (C-5). Exact encoding is residue, not decided here.
